timeline.text: Once lesson videos could render on their own, nothing checked them before a kid saw them.
One broken animation, one overlapping label, could have gone straight to the TV on the wall.
Now a 'blind viewer' judges a contact sheet of every video, frame by frame, before anyone else sees it.
Only a passing video ever reaches my kids — the whole thing renders unattended on a VPS.
It checks for new lessons every fifteen minutes, nonstop.
